_about: Public-domain Isaac Crook (1833-1916), Methodist minister and president of Ohio University, for the Word Hoard: Jonathan Edwards, John Knox the Reformer, The Earnest Expectation, The Great Five (the first faculty of Ohio Wesleyan), and his memorial of C. C. White. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 116 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
